summary: Linkage Global Inc, a Cayman-incorporated Japan-based e-commerce company, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a 23-for-1 share consolidation adopted by special resolution on September 8, 2026 and effective September 18, 2026. The amended articles restate capital as US$2,525,000 divided into 43,391,304.3478261 Class A shares at US$0.0575 par and 521,739.130434783 Class B shares. No price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. Mechanics mirror a reverse split, typically used to restore Nasdaq minimum bid compliance while shrinking share count. Watch for post-consolidation trading price, fractional-share cash-outs, and any subsequent Nasdaq deficiency notice.
